title: ENOSPC during blob publication leaves the envelope untouched

steps.action: publish the blob with the §5.1 write procedure
classify the on-disk state and return
next open removes leftover temp files

durableEffects: at most a leftover temp file under sources/ (removed on the next open)
observations: retry of the same requestId re-runs the publication (no record was written)
an existing blob with a different content but the same name is never overwritten (content-addressed name + digest verification)

notes: Maps §5.1 write failure onto the content phase without weakening the envelope guarantees.
